references.text: Moses introduces the commands, statutes, and laws that Israel is to keep, the same theme as in 6:1.
Moses emphasizes that he has taught the people statutes and laws which the Lord commanded, so that they might follow them in the land they are about to enter.
The Lord commands Moses to teach the people all the commands, statutes, and laws they are to keep in the land.
Introduction to the statutes and laws that are to be kept in the land the Lord gives them.
The conclusion of Leviticus, summarizing the statutes and laws the Lord gave through Moses.
Introduction to the laws that Moses is to present to the people.
Summary of the commands and statutes given on the plains of Moab before entering the land.
Jesus emphasizes the importance of keeping and teaching others the commands, in line with Moses' mission.
Jesus' command to teach disciples to keep all he has commanded, parallel to Moses' teaching mission.
